user_request: All 85 reviewed crowded non-other windows + all 5009 old train windows + 85 reviewed other; preserve old val/test by explicit user reply.
new_splits: Original split field is historical provenance only; train_selected overrides it for all new positives.
conflict_policy: User approved excluding every intersecting window; original JSON preserved
excluded_policy: Excluded entity: entire track across generations. Uncertain intervals: +/-1 second. Conflicts: every overlapping input window.
weak_policy: No pseudo-label training or scoring; no XCLIP.
old_policy: Keep frozen old source splits. Prefer current frontend at same-person exact source-frame windows (>=26/32 boxes IoU>=.8); preserve legacy-only windows and all sources. Report canonical and legacy separately.

training.sampling: Class/source weighted, old/new mass .7/.3 when both exist; new other mass .1. All 85 positives enrolled; 85 human other from original new train only.
training.checkpoint_selection: Old canonical val only. Branch diagnostics at .75; joint fixed full-scheme parameters. No crowded label is used as held-out selection data.
training.epoch_draws_reason: Match previous effective full batches: RGB700x8, skeleton59x64; isolate data selection rather than reduce optimizer updates.
training.initialized_from: Original production weights, not prior finetune checkpoints

tuning.objective: Old canonical val only: every supported positive-class recall >= baseline-.05; minimize old-other FPR, then supported macro F1 and positive TP; deterministic earlier-epoch tie-break. Also retain best trained-only pair and fixed last pair as predeclared diagnostics.
tuning.geometry: Fixed matched ROI/action windows; frame-level luma masks applied to skeleton and priors. Full frontend replay of selected configuration required before deployment claim.

historical_test_limit: All crowded positives include the former val/test and are now training data. No crowded positive holdout remains. Unselected crowded other shares capture groups/people with training. Old source splits are preserved but historically inspected, so old test is regression only.

evaluation.crowded_positives: Training fit for all 85; not independent accuracy/generalization
evaluation.crowded_other: Separate 85 trained and remaining 566 untrained windows; same-source diagnostics, not independent negatives
